info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Molecules Summary API

params.name: molecule_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of molecule_ids to query on

params.name: formula
params.description: Query by alphabetical formula. A comma delimited string list of alphabetical formulas can also be provided.

params.name: chemsys
params.description: A comma delimited string list of chemical systems. Wildcards for unknown elements only supported for single chemsys queries

params.name: elements
params.description: Query by elements in the material composition as a comma-separated list

params.name: exclude_elements
params.description: Query by excluded elements in the material composition as a comma-separated list

params.name: has_props
params.description: Comma-delimited list of possible properties given by HasPropsEnum to search for.

params.name: charge
params.description: Query by molecular charge

params.name: spin_multiplicity
params.description: Query by molecular spin multiplicity.

params.name: inchi
params.description: International chemical identifier (InChI) string for this molecule

params.name: inchi_key
params.description: Hash of the InChI, also known as the InChI-key

params.name: species_hash
params.description: Graph hash augmented with node species

params.name: coord_hash
params.description: Graph hash augmented with node XYZ coordinates

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: nelements_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of nelements

params.name: nelements_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of nelements

params.name: nelements
params.description: Query for nelements being equal to an exact value

params.name: nelements_not_eq
params.description: Query for nelements being not equal to an exact value

params.name: nelements_eq_any
params.description: Query for nelements being any of these values. Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: nelements_neq_any
params.description: Query for nelements being not any of these values.                             Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: _sort_fields
params.description: Comma delimited fields to sort with. Prefixing '-' to a field will force a sort in descending order.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from MoleculeSummaryDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `charge` `spin_multiplicity` `natoms` `elements` `nelements` `nelectrons` `composition` `composition_reduced` `formula_alphabetical` `formula_pretty` `formula_anonymous` `chemsys` `symmetry` `species_hash` `coord_hash` `property_name` `property_id` `molecule_id` `deprecated` `deprecation_reasons` `level_of_theory` `solvent` `lot_solvent` `last_updated` `origins` `warnings` `molecules` `molecule_levels_of_theory` `inchi` `inchi_key` `task_ids` `similar_molecules` `constituent_molecules` `unique_calc_types` `unique_task_types` `unique_levels_of_theory` `unique_solvents` `unique_lot_solvents` `thermo` `vibration` `orbitals` `partial_charges` `partial_spins` `bonding` `multipole_moments` `redox` `metal_binding` `has_props`

params.name: _all_fields
params.description: Include all fields.
